deployments_detail.use: AI across Ion lung-biopsy navigational workflow (FDA-cleared) + da Vinci surgical insights analytics

Case Insights: AI/ML 'computational observer' that evaluates da Vinci 5 system data, instrument kinematics, and surgical video to produce objective post-operative performance insights, auto-bookmark key video moments, and track surgeon skill trends over time. Commercially available with da Vinci 5 (one free year bundled with new dV5 systems). [Intuitive (in-house ML)]

My Intuitive+ AI-powered video analysis: mobile/console platform delivering Case Insights, targeted (auto-bookmarked) video review, and actionable performance guidance to surgeons; available exclusively with da Vinci 5 + upgraded software. [Intuitive]

Ion endoluminal system AI-powered enhanced navigation for lung biopsy: AI compares live imaging to the original plan and adjusts the navigation view to address CT-to-body divergence when nodules shift during bronchoscopy. FDA-cleared, in limited launch, broader US launch planned 2026. [Intuitive]

Computer-vision models that detect and track surgical instruments in da Vinci procedure video, trained on labeled surgical video data (spatial training signal). Used to power surgical scene understanding / analytics. [Labelbox (labeling platform); Intuitive CV models]

Surgical AI foundation models trained on Intuitive's proprietary dataset of 20M+ da Vinci procedures, presented at the 2025 Society of Robotic Surgery meeting as the base for a five-layer AI roadmap (insights, intraoperative guidance, augmented dexterity, supervised autonomy). Company states its models outperformed general-purpose AI on surgical tasks. [Intuitive (in-house)]

Collaboration with KelaHealth to develop machine-learning models that use real-time AI to predict a patient's risk of surgical complications, feeding clinical and robotics data into the predictive engine. [KelaHealth]

Research (with academic partners, published via NVIDIA) using imitation-learning AI to let a da Vinci research robot autonomously perform key surgical tasks (needle manipulation, tissue lifting, suturing) as precisely as humans, on NVIDIA GPU/AI stack. Foreshadows supervised-autonomy layer of Intuitive roadmap. [NVIDIA (compute); Johns Hopkins / Stanford researchers using da Vinci]

Real-time intraoperative AI guidance in development: augmenting sensory information and providing surgeons with real-time guidance during a procedure, plus AI/ML tools to help surgeons learn from complex cases. Described as being built, not yet deployed. [Intuitive]

AI-assisted telesurgery demonstration connecting facilities in Sunnyvale, CA and Atlanta, GA, showcasing remote robotic surgery capabilities enabled by Intuitive's AI/connectivity stack (announced at 2025 SRS meeting). [Intuitive]
